notes.title: Update v1.07 - Beginner difficulty!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/7cb5248db2f2f93ed12c94a90f6780ae8b7365bf.png[/img]

[h3]Hello fighters!

After several days of testing and rebalancing, this update finally adds the [u]beginner difficulty[/u] to Carsteroids.[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/ea2c88ff653cdf4004bd975b6e98a392edea0781.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/ab23811fff1b54f79f25ec850277e8ad79afc693.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/5c76c168afc875f9b97a3a71ebf1bb359c9503d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/91c6dbd6cbf12e6553440200cc9ddb98760c6d41.png[/img][/url]

This is a long time requested feature that finally lands after having balanced the "normal" and "less hard" difficulty, aiming to give the opportunity also to the players who prefer a less challenging experience to enjoy the game.
This new difficulty setting is still a true Carsteroids experience, but with a small feature added. After selection, it simply [b]increases your car maximum energy[/b] so that you can take more hits and last longer in the combat arena. As a result, when you play in story mode, [b]you will also receive more money[/b] to spend on upgrades after you clear a stage.

Hope this new addition can give a better gameplay experience, especially to the players who are having hard time when playing the other difficulty settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/152f39a2c39d77257934710f5be123874ea050ee.png[/img] 
There is also [b]a new paint job[/b] to unlock in the arcade mode. 
It's named "N-Wave" and you can have it for just 50 tokens :)


That's all for now!
As always thanks for your feedback and thanks for playing!


See you in the arena,
[i]bkdove[/i]


[h3]v1.07 Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the new "Beginner" difficulty setting. 
[*] Rebalanced token spawning and score bonuses. 
[*] Slower car-ball cpu when playing beginner difficulty. 
[*] Energy +10 power-up now has a random timeout. 
[*] Adjusted the maximum speed of The Redeemer. 
[*] Added the third paint job for the Arcade mode. 
[*] Added music to the Arcade ending credits. 
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: The half-dead slave - a Carsteroids short story
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/4ab81ff1cf5d3222bee3224ce68cdcf2522a0b7a.png[/img]

[h3]The half-dead slave[/h3]
A Carsteroids short story


[i]Unlucky people do not exist, it all depends on their state of mind. 
Weak people do not exist, it all depends on the tools in their possession.[/i]


I was a slave of sector 74, assigned to the 10th wave deployment with the promise of freedom if I contributed to beating the main player in the combat arena. That’s every slave prize: stop your target, avoid being killed and you’re free to go. And if you achieve that, stay away from troubles in Vesta City or the troopers will bring you back here. 

This arena fight is not a complicated task. The only problem is that you’re on foot with only a rifle while your opponent is a combat car, but apart from this small particular you can count on your squad members, if they manage to stay alive.
I was ready, mentally trained and half brainwashed, with just my legs, my weapon and a black helmet like the ones who only show chin and mouth. 

I jumped in the deployment truck assigned to stage 11, a hell of flames and metal. The other 5 guys from my squad continued to scream during the short trip. I stared at their desperate faces before the back door slammed on the burned floor. 
Slaves mostly die in the arena, they are just part of the entertainment, but that was not my case, at least in part.
We were lucky our driver was a good one, he avoided a minefield on the left and several debris in flames. If a driver dies before he can stop the truck and open the deployment door, we slaves are dead too. You know what I mean.

The combat area was bigger than I imagined, a former warehouse converted into a fighting arena, very impressive. The audience was screaming, the stage lights were blinding and several rays of light were penetrating a big cloud of grey smoke. Some debris fell from above. I checked if my helmet was properly fastened.
The first thing I saw was a yellow laser shooting through the cloud of smoke and I heard screaming tires. That was our main target, a fully armored black Viper model, drifting while disappearing again in the same cloud of smoke. We all shot with our rifles, we wanted that promised freedom. We didn’t hit.
There was zero cover, our truck was gone. No wrecked car skeletons around. I realized why slaves die so often in the Carsteroids arenas. I also realized you have a few seconds to discharge all your firepower praying for your good aim and especially praying that your opponent does not notice you too soon.
We stayed in formation, we saw again our target on the right, it was busy trying to avoid a couple of explosive barrels. We shot and we hit!
The barrels exploded, but the Viper spotted us and quickly turned around. He was on fire and charging us at full speed. We maintained our formation, we screamed and kept shooting straight ahead.

The last thing I remember was the metallic bumper breaking my leg, me falling on the ground and the car passing on my arm. The helmet saved my head, but half of my body died.

After that battle all our squad achieved freedom, but I am the only one able to tell it.


[h3]----[/h3]

Thanks for reading, hope you liked it! 
Your mysterious friend from the V-troopers has another promo code for you, taken from the "Service Interface Corp." database:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/a43c72b0bc2d1670b734b7fa7c6ce433b752d89c.png[/img]
The code is: HNVT
Redeem the code in the main menu and you will receive 5 shields to use in your next arcade or story run.

Game start!
[i]bkdove[/i]

notes.title: Update v1.06t
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/35fe8cfc54e76f7c609142c64bfb5a18edbc9d19.png[/img]

[b]Hello pilots!
Carsteroids just received a new update based on your feedback, thanks very much![/b]

This update is about balancing the difficulty and the score bonuses based on it. Because the game has now a third difficulty level, any extra bonus received will be proportioned to the difficulty chosen.

The [u]new selectable difficulty level[/u]  is named "[b]normal (alt)[/b]". This is just an alternative variant to "normal" featuring the same difficulty, but with automatic reload. 

Also, when playing a "Car-ball" single match Vs the CPU you can now [u]win tokens for each goal you score[/u] (if you don't lose the match, of course). This change should give an additional reason to choose a single match instead of the tournament.

Here the full changelog, let me know what you think!


[b]v1.06t changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the third difficulty level (same as normal, but with automatic reload and a slightly smaller extra bonus for the score).
[*] Renamed "Versus" to "Car-ball" in the title page.
[*] Renamed "Extra" to "Bonus Round" in the title page.
[*] In a Car-ball single match Vs the CPU now you can win tokens for each goal you score.
[*] When playing Story/Arcade the player now receives a bonus score based on chosen difficulty.
[*] When playing "Bonus Round" on normal difficulty the player now receives a +20% bonus score.
[*] Fixed a bug in Arcade mode preventing the player to advance to the next stage.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing to properly show the reloading message on screen.
[*] Other small fixes.
[/list]

See you in the games!
[i]bkdove studios[/i]

notes.title: Update v1.05 - Difficulty balancement, checkpoint saving & more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/6eb226d2cd9b33248ef2148234cbb3fcbc5bd203.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hello fighters!
Thanks to your feedbacks the update 1.05 is now live.
This update is mainly about difficulty balancement and savegames, but also other things listed below.[/h3]

[b]1. Difficulty[/b]

You face many types of opponents in Carsteroids, but they can mainly be categorized in primary and secondary. Primary opponents spawn once at the start of a game (they're your main target) and secondary opponents spawn at some intervals during a play. Before this update a game could have been infinite because the continous spawning of secondary opponents. After this update when you beat a primary opponent no more secondary opponent will enter the combat (now a secondary target enters the arena only if the primary target is still in play).
This change brought a significative alteration to the "ecosystem" of Carsteroids because with less secondary opponents less points are generated and consequentially the player might earn less money for the upgrades. So it took a while to rebalance all the factors for a good compromise between all of them. Hopefully the gameplay will be better balanced now.

[b]2. Saving[/b]

Because the game automatically saves at certain points to preserve the unlocks and the overall progress, when I added the possibility to manually save, the load of a checkpoint started to mess all of this. Now with this upgrade when starting a new game (independently if it's arcade, story or versus) the game always overwrites the previous data deleting also the story mode saved checkpoint. This is the best option to keep all the data for a game born on roguelite foundations and featuring 3 different main modes connected between each other.

[b]3. More...[/b]

Lastly, some improvements to the reload notifications and some AI upgrades to give to your opponent a little more of unpredictability. Below you can find the complete changelog. Game on!


[b]v1.05 changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added "reload" voice on zero shots (normal difficulty). 
[*] Added "reloading" sound on button pressed. 
[*] Remaining shots' HUD info now counts downward. 
[*] Now the game automatically records a leaderboard score on "quick restart". 
[*] Reduced screen-shake magnitude from stage 6 onwards. 
[*] Added a new save checkpoint on stage 15. 
[*] Upgraded boss' hit points for stage 10 and stage 15. 
[*] Opponents' combat AI updated. 
[*] No more secondary opponent is spawned after you beat the primary target. 
[*] Rotating opponent now holds the fire when spawning bombs on later stages. 
[*] Reduced secondary opponent's respawn rate (for early stages and easier difficulty). 
[*] Reduced fire rate of walking opponents. 
[*] Reduced quantity of scattered tires on easier difficulty. 
[*] Tire sprite outline is now a little darker. 
[*] Adjusted Parasite's beam collision box. 
[*] Increased Parasite's 3-way shooting interval. 
[*] Updated description of "Less Hard" difficulty option. 
[*] Updated load/save/new game brief descriptions. 
[*] Added savegame informations before starting a new game. 
[/list]

FIXES:
[list]
[*] No more opponent is spawned after you hear the gong. 
[*] Gamepad's select button in the controls page now works again. 
[*] Drones are no more automatically destroyed when you wreck the Deployer. 
[*] Fixed loss of progress caused when reloading a save state. 
[*] Fixed bonus stage 4 bug preventing the timer to work. 
[*] Fixed collision bug between beam shot and enemy shield. 
[*] Money earned playing Parasites's intro stage are now kept after a quick restart. 
[*] "Invincible" achievement trigger is no more randomly activated. 
[*] Achievement "Car-ball favourite" now triggers on the spot. 
[*] Other minor fixes. 
[/list]

notes.title: Continuing & Saving
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/4ab81ff1cf5d3222bee3224ce68cdcf2522a0b7a.png[/img]

Hi Pilots,
thanks to your feedbacks I added the possibility to [b]continue[/b] your game when playing the [u]Arcade Mode[/u] and the possibility to [b]save[/b] the game when playing the [u]Story Mode[/u]. This is a major upgrade that adjusts the gameplay in a better way. The game is still difficult but now it gives you the opportunity to replay some stages defying the permadeath. 

Here are the main added features in detail:


[h3]CONTINUE?[/h3]
During an arcade wave, when your energy is depleted, the game will display two additional options on the game over screen: Continue or Give Up. If you use a continue, you will receive your full energy back to be able to keep playing the current stage. The continues are limited for each new game (3) and you'll need to have a few tokens to use them. The continues are available from wave 2 onwards.


[h3]CHECKPOINT![/h3]
You can save the game every time you encounter a checkpoint. At moment there are 2 checkpoints, located between story stages 5-6 and 10-11, precisely after you beat the level 5 boss and the level 10 boss. When you save a checkpoint you can restart from that precise stage if you prefer, using your current gear. To make things a bit challenging, you can save your state only if you have 50 tokens. 


[h3]OTHER STUFF:[/h3]
I also tuned the car steering for tighter turns and I made some other adjustments and additions listed down here. Game on!



[b]Full 1.02 changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added option to continue when playing Arcade Mode. 
[*] Checkpoints to save state in the Story Mode. 
[*] Adjusted car steering speed. 
[*] Now you can steer the car also using the d-pad. 
[*] Title music updated with the extended version. 
[*] You can now toggle the music during the gameplay. 
[*] New sponsor added in the arena. 
[*] Easy difficulty renamed to "less hard". 
[*] Leaderboard is now used for the arcade mode only. 
[*] Added drift instruction when playing the tutorial. 
[*] Control instructions' image updated. 
[*] Boss music is now playing in loop. 
[*] Added sounds in pause menu. 
[*] Fixed double score bug in leaderboard. 
[*] Minor gameplay/UI bugfixes.
[/list]

[i]"Imagine a dark future, after Earth resources are depleted.
Mankind is gone to the stars. The resource extraction takes place on the Asteroid belt. After the mining age another dark age came. Civil war, Alien encounters, new technology mixes with the old one... They made a mess in the sky.
Imagine to live an adventure in that period of time. Close your eyes."[/i]

[b]Hope to let you enjoy this soon![/b]


[h1][b]Second: [/b][/h1]
if you don't have Carsteroids yet (or if you have it, of course!) you can play the [u]free game[/u]  C-ZERO (Carsteroids Zero). It is a very arcade spin-off I uploaded to the web. The game is skill based, centered on the V-troopers training ground. I hope you have the right skills to succeed ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/89d69e0f3c7cbd3dc37d49d4fcab3c8daf3ef5f4.png[/img]

[i]"You are a recruit of the V-Troopers, the main force of the Asteroid Vesta.
Your duty is to test experimental weapons using a combat car that the enforcers will use on the battlefield.
Your goal is to resist for 150 seconds, planning every shot. Only one rule: Don’t be hit."[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/5d815113bda4822449d35ff50ed6c823a538111f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/c457d1ad83716e56c0af26ec35802d844c12620a.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/ce92df86c8a21ee7d065194d3208e51423884dbd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/65e9831ff3d2542ddfd70b49ee5ec545eaeedce7.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/85fe26aed92510ba8d650caa29be8e74264b998c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088231/61fb8a30a1ebd54cc9aeac46c7d6345763d49f24.jpg[/img][/url]

C-ZERO is a spin-off, played by the point of view of the V-Troopers, one of the antagonists of the main game Carsteroids.

[b]Play here:[/b]
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/739265
or
https://www.kongregate.com/games/bkdove/c-zero


As always I thank you for the feedbacks, for the kind support and for all the love received! 

See you on the Asteroids Belt!

[h1]Hi pilots, with this update the v1.0 is getting closer. While testing and adjusting gameplay for a stable version, there's still time for new additions:[/h1]

[b][Play ball versus CPU][/b]
No need to wait your friend to sit beside you anymore: now the CPU can be your friend and play car-ball with you. But the cpu can be really challenging sometimes, hope you won't rage quit! Also, the action camera is now active for the vs mode.

[b][Got hi-score? Leaderboard!][/b]
If you like the old arcades and like to go for the highest score, now you can. The "best scores" leaderboard has been added. 
There is also a "total score bonus" that automatically adds at the end of each stage for normal difficulty players. This has been introduced to balance the easy/normal difficulty final scores. 

[b][What's next?][/b]
A new trailer including the new features on its way, plus some gameplay videos on the youtube channel. Game on!

I added also the [u][b]final stage for the 3rd unlockable pilot[/b][/u]. With this last addition all the unlockable pilots' stories are complete. Every character has a personal objective and an exclusive final fight from now.

notes.title: Sharp action! - update 0.998
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32088231/90f017b512d05a3b82e6abd0798a3063ea1e6b6a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hello pilots, with this update I added some new features for an improved and more various gameplay:[/h1]

[b]The first one is the new action camera.[/b] The layout view is now automatically zoomed in/out to better follow the main fight. I think this feature adds more dynamicity to the car combat, hope you'll like it.

[b]The second feature is a new arena pickup: the Deadly Disc.[/b] It is dropped by the normal crates and it consists in a flying disc (or saucer?) that flies beside your car and shoots at your opponents. It has limited bullets, after they're depleted it'll fly away.

[b]The final character has been released.[/b] He is a close-combat fighter with an installed [b]Energy Blade[/b] and an automatic [b]Heal System[/b] which slowly recovers the vehicle's energy. 
With this character you'll experience a different way of playing the game because he is really powerful, but the Blade drains energy from your car so you won't have unlimited shots anymore. He can also buy a ranged weapon in the shop just in case you don't prefer the close combat. You can unlock him on completing the main player's "bad ending". 
I'll add this player's story with a next update.

Another new feature worth to mention is that you now may jam your weapon if you use it improperly. If you press the fire button and the reload button at the same time (too many times!) your weapon might jam.

[i]Thank you very much for your support. I hope you'll report any bug and/or post any thoughts about Carsteroids. Game on![/i]

[h1]Here's the full 0.998 changelog:[/h1]

[b]New features:[/b]
- Dynamic combat camera. 
- New arena powerup: Deadly Disc. 
- New unlockable hero: Soka Shirawa. 
- New weapon: Energy Blade. 
- New weapon: Shuriken. 
- Added money bonus on completing Parasite's level 0. 
- Added "Ready" screen when arcade starts. 
- Now you may jam your weapon after an improper use. 
- Arcade final score screen added.  
- Alternate afterstage screen added (elevator). 
- New background holo-advertising added. 
- Carships' thruster animation is now nicer. 
- Added "hits taken" counter for player 2. 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Added missing sound effect for the flamethrower. 
- Adjusted drone spawning and rate of fire. 
- Bosses' hp rebalanced. 
- Score bug fixed. 
- Hits system fixed. 
- Scavenger collisions fixed. 
- Other minor fixes.

[h1]Hello! Introducing a new unlockable player with this update: The Redeemer, a fanatic competitor with a very particular mission. You can unlock him after collecting 1000 tokens.[/h1]

[b]The Redeemer has his personal story (as the other characters) with a unique intro, a final fight and a unique ending. Armed with the Spread Shot as primary weapon, his modified car has a secondary fire mode: a powerful flamethrower. You can activate it by keeping down the fire button. He also comes with a unique weapon to buy in the shop: The fireball.[/b]

Everything in contact with flames can trigger an "on fire" status. When something is on fire receives a constant damage for some seconds. The flames can not be blocked or deflected by shields.

I also made some adjustments to the difficulty levels and to the enemy AI. There is still much to do, but for the moment I hope you'll enjoy!

notes.title: Orbiting and Bonusing - Update v0.995h
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32088231/b320e3c52cc5086e10e5eb25aeecf0fec3a397ff.jpg[/img]
[h1] Hi everyone, with the last update I added a new passive weapon (Orbiter), another bonus stage (no.4) and made some gameplay adjustments. [/h1]

My main goal is to make every playtime different from the previous one and obviously more enjoyable. 

The Orbiter is spawned by the crates in the main arena and creates four energy spheres orbiting around your car. Every sphere causes 2-6 contact damage to your adversaries, it can deflect enemy bullets and it's destroyed on collision. 
I find it useful when the stage is full of mines and the orbiter destroys the mines before you touch them.

Stage bonus 4 is a horizontal shoot'em up stage where you earn money as usual. You have to pick up coins and shoot barrels to increase your money bonus. Coins also increase your coin counter. 
You can accelerate to increase speed and reduce the quantity of the obstacles. The stage is over if your counter is zero or your car touches a barrel.

Hoping to get your feedback:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/671470/discussions/

-----------------

[h1] Hello! After the first feedbacks I made some tunings regarding the controls and I added the super requested easy mode: [/h1]

The car turning radius now improves at slower speed and it's worse at higher speed, but it is now possible to drift by keeping the accelerator and the brake button down. This is great when you want to surprise your opponent making a quick u-turn.
The easy difficulty has been activated and you can change it in the main screen page before selecting a game mode. With this mode your opponents have less hit points; this gives to you a good advantage on them and you'll have more money to spend on gear at the end of each stage (story mode).
Also, I made other minor adjustments. Here is the v0.994e changelog:

notes.title: v0.992 - Less hard!
notes.content:
Game updated after many feedbacks about the very hard difficulty. I really wanted to make a difficult game but maybe it's too much :) so I tuned up some enemy behaviour and made some damage adjustments:

- The spinning enemies now cause less damage. 
- The aggressive cars don't push you anymore and cause less damage. 
- The first boss now has a reduced rate of fire. 
- Introduced the "perfect" bonus (you unlock it when you have 100% energy plus 100% accuracy). 
- Added random emails: you can now receive special offers on your BBS terminal to buy in the shop. 
- Made small ajustments on the gear panel (all about the link between shop items and the stats they give). 
- Added some guides on steam. 
- The mutiplayer experience is smoother now. 
- Two new gameplay music added. 
- Added Linux support. 
- Fixed too many bugs!
